Our Mission · Matthew 28:19

Go, therefore, and make disciples

Our mission is to spread the holy gospel of Jesus Christ and to make disciples of all nations, just as Christ commanded His followers. Everything we do — our worship, our teaching, our fellowship — flows from this calling.

Only By Grace Worship Center exists to be a home in Rehoboth where people meet Jesus, grow in faith, and are equipped to carry the gospel into their own homes, workplaces, and communities.

Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.

Matthew 28:19
Pastor Colin Van Wyk Leading our congregation with a heart for the Word and for the people God has placed in our care.
